insights.title: Primary Interruption Driver: Direct Slack messages
insights.description: Direct Slack messages accounted for 162 events (39.7% of all recorded potential interruptions) across engineering teams.

insights.title: Focus Block Duration Variance
insights.description: Data Engineering achieved the longest average focus block duration at 107.4 minutes, compared to 86.3 minutes in Product Engineering.

insights.title: Elevated Context-Switching Tax in Product Engineering
insights.description: Product Engineering averaged an estimated 19.1% context-switching tax due to frequent interruptions and task transitions.

insights.title: Peak Interruption Window
insights.description: Interruption frequency peaked between 13:00 and 14:00 UTC with 87 recorded events, aligning with core pull request and build cycles.
